title: Protocol and Machine Anew
author: O. M. Joubert
blurb: Hazel Halloran, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
